name: Tape Room
description: Reel-to-reel player with a shared album catalogue, artists, personal collections, playlists and audio chapters.

description_i18n.ru: Катушечный плеер с общим каталогом альбомов, артистами, личной коллекцией, плейлистами и таймкодами.
description_i18n.en: Reel-to-reel player with a shared album catalogue, artists, personal collections, playlists and audio chapters.

author: FIREBALL CMS
release_notes: Keep images and focused controls in place during playback and library updates.
Add searchable album genres and an administrator genre library.
Review album submissions before they appear in the shared catalogue; show per-user album statistics.
Read bounded Google Drive audio tags, durations and embedded or folder cover art; reuse the playback cache.
Stream WebRTC torrents directly in the browser, with a local personal library, tags and artwork; no server audio storage.
